Name: MineConcession
Author: zoe20050217
Description:
[b]Description [/b]
MineConcession is a fun, story-driven parody mod that lets you take over Pelican Town's mining operations. After uncovering Mayor Lewis's "unexplained account deficit," you can buy out the mine's concession rights for 50,000g, forcing Clint to lower his prices drastically and offer VIP services to you!

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI (v3.14.0 or higher)

[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Mayor Lewis Confrontation: Trigger a custom dialogue with Lewis to buy the mining concession.[/*]
[*]Clint's VIP Service: Clint's attitude flips—get Coal for just 15g and enjoy heavily discounted prices on all ores and minerals.[/*]
[*]Flexible Tool Upgrade System (New!): Choose how you want your tools upgraded without paying both gold and ores at the same time:[/*]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Pay with Ores only: Free service with next-day home delivery straight to your mailbox—no need to visit the shop![/*]
[*]Pay with Gold only: Buy ready-made tools directly over the counter for instant, same-day delivery![/*]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Note:[/b] A pure C# code mod made for fun—not strictly balanced!
[/*]
[/list][b]How to Play[/b]
Step 1: Buy the Mining Concession
[list]
[*]Requirement: Have more than 50,000g in cash.[/*]
[*]Action: Talk to Mayor Lewis with over 50,000g on hand to trigger the custom dialogue and purchase the concession.[/*]
[/list]Step 2: Unlock Clint's VIP Services
[list]
[*]Action: After purchasing the concession from Lewis, go to the Blacksmith shop and talk to Clint directly.[/*]
[*]Once you see Clint backing down dialogue, his shop counter will be upgraded with VIP services.[/*]
[/list]Step 3: Tool Upgrades & Discounted Shop
[list]
[*]Discounted Ores & Coal: Access Clint's counter for heavily discounted ores, minerals, and 15g Coal.[/*]
[*]Tool Upgrade Mechanism:
[list]
[*]Hold the target tool in your hands when upgrading at the counter.[/*]
[*]Default Trash Can: If you are not holding any upgradable tool in your hands, the upgrade will default to your Trash Can.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][b]Pro Tip: Make sure to select the FIRST dialogue option each time when talking to Mayor Lewis to officially purchase the concession for 50,000g. Other options will just end up in Lewis's pocket! 😉


Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the .zip archive.[/*]
[*]Drop the extracted MineConcession folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using StardewModdingAPI.exe .[/*]
[/list][b]Shout Outs[/b]
Special thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for the awesome tutorials, the players from my initial demo video for their valuable feedback, and SMAPI developers for building such a great framework!
